# City of Birmingham, Alabama

> Official website for the City of Birmingham, Alabama, providing government services, news, and information under Mayor Randall L. Woodfin's administration.

Birmingham's municipal website serves residents with access to city departments including the Birmingham Police Department, Birmingham Fire and Rescue Services, and the Department of Innovation and Economic Opportunity. The site features press releases on community development initiatives, workforce programs, neighborhood revitalization efforts, and city services.

## Key Topics

- Mayor Randall L. Woodfin
- Birmingham Police Department
- Birmingham Fire and Rescue Services
- Department of Innovation and Economic Opportunity
- Birmingham City Council
- Workforce development programs
- Community revitalization
- Affordable housing and homeownership
- Federal grants and funding
- Neighborhood development
- Birmingham Land Bank Authority
- Public safety and recruitment
- Economic opportunity initiatives
- Historic preservation

## City Government and Departments

- [Office of Public Information](https://www.birminghamal.gov/government/mayors-office/office-public-information): Mayor's Office of Public Information for media and city communications
- [Enterprise Systems Division](https://www.birminghamal.gov/government/city-departments/information-management-services/enterprise-systems-division): IT division for app development, databases, and ERP systems
- [Public Records Request](https://www.birminghamal.gov/government/city-departments/city-clerks-office/public-records-request): Alabama residents can request public records via City Clerk's office
- [2024-2026 Poet Laureate](https://www.birminghamal.gov/government/mayors-office/office-public-information/2024-2026-poet-laureate): Salaam Green serves as Birmingham's 2024-2026 Poet Laureate

## Public Safety and Employment

- [Join the Police Department Team](https://www.birminghamal.gov/government/city-departments/birmingham-police-department/join-police-department-team): Birmingham Police Department recruitment and application information
- [Mayor Appoints Interim Deputy Chief of Special Operations](https://www.birminghamal.gov/news/mayor-appoints-interim-deputy-chief-special-operations): JaCorey Foster appointed interim deputy chief of special operations
- [Keena Dowdell saves man from burning home, named honorary firefighter](https://www.birminghamal.gov/news/keena-dowdell-saves-man-burning-home-named-honorary-firefighter): Keena Dowdell honored as firefighter after heroic house fire rescue

## Economic Development and Workforce Programs

- [City of Birmingham selected as finalist for U.S. Dept. of Commerce grant](https://www.birminghamal.gov/news/city-birmingham-selected-finalist-us-dept-commerce-economic-opportunity-workforce-development): Birmingham finalist for EDA Distressed Area Recompete Pilot Program
- [City of Birmingham partners with United Ability in employment program](https://www.birminghamal.gov/news/city-birmingham-partners-united-ability-employment-program): United Ability partnership for disability employment program
- [New funds could mean more grocery stores coming to Birmingham](https://www.birminghamal.gov/news/new-funds-could-mean-more-grocery-stores-coming-birmingham): $2M grocery store recruitment plan for underserved Birmingham areas
- [Baker finds sweet success with Last Call Baking Co.](https://www.birminghamal.gov/news/baker-finds-sweet-success-after-setbacks-launch-last-call-baking-co): Chanah Willis opens Last Call Baking Co. after pandemic challenges

## Housing and Neighborhood Revitalization

- [Home for the Holidays: Homeownership program in Fountain Heights](https://www.birminghamal.gov/news/press-releases-home-holidays-series-homeownership-program-set-revive-fountain-heights-neighborhood-one-home-time): Michael Reed's homeownership story via AHOP in Fountain Heights

## Community Services and Events

- [Plan Your Visit to Boutwell Auditorium](https://www.birminghamal.gov/government/city-departments/boutwell-auditorium/plan-your-visit-boutwell-auditorium): Visitor guide for Boutwell Auditorium: parking, policies, amenities
- [City of Birmingham to host meeting for food trucks at Sloss Furnaces](https://www.birminghamal.gov/news/city-birmingham-host-meeting-food-trucks-sloss-furnaces-sept-16-2024): Food truck operator meeting at Sloss Furnaces on Sept. 16, 2024
- [Birmingham's municipal court receives $2 million for drug court](https://www.birminghamal.gov/news/city-birminghams-municipal-court-receives-2-million-continue-work-drug-court): $2M federal grant for drug court program with Aletheia House

## Infrastructure and City Projects

- [Second Avenue South District gets a facelift](https://www.birminghamal.gov/news/second-avenue-south-district-gets-facelift): Second Avenue South complete streets redesign with bike lanes
- [Messer Airport Highway Underpass re-opened today](https://www.birminghamal.gov/news/messer-airport-highway-underpass-re-opened-today): Messer Airport Highway underpass reopens after flood remediation
